svg.title: The live facts of the home pages
svg.desc: Every two hours the Dashboard workflow of the blueprint publishes repos.json, history.json and releases.atom at dennis-otto.github.io/repo-blueprint/dashboard/. Every day, and with every change of main, the Docs workflow builds this website, and its hooks write the repository of every project and the level of its OpenSSF Best Practices, which they read from bestpractices.dev, into its card. As a home page loads in a reader's browser, docs/javascripts/projects.js reads repos.json from the same address, or history.json when it can't, and writes the release, its day and the quality numbers into every card and the newest release of each project under What's new. Without the data or the script, every card keeps what the build wrote. A feed reader follows releases.atom, which What's new links.
